u0: Nothing is currently left owing: the siren is not waiting to be switched off, no arrived client is waiting to be served, and no recently dropped food must be recovered immediately. This is the caught-up, ongoing situation in the shop; future rings, arrivals, or slips create new obligations, and otherwise the agent can keep working. There is no terminal goal to reach, so the task continues until the episode ends.
u1: The siren is ringing and still needs to be switched off; this is the only outstanding requirement. No client is unserved and no immediately dropped food is awaiting recovery. Switching the siren off clears this obligation, though a client arriving or food slipping on that same step can add a new one.
u2: Food has just slipped from the agent's hands and must be picked up on the very next step; this immediate recovery is the only outstanding requirement. The siren does not need attention and no client is waiting to be served. If the food is recovered next step the obligation clears; if the next step passes without holding the food, the task fails irreversibly.
u3: Both the siren and a just-slipped food are outstanding: the food must be picked up on the very next step, and the still-ringing siren must eventually be switched off. No client is waiting to be served. The next step must restore the food to the agent's hands; after that, the siren remains to be silenced.
u4: A client has arrived and is still owed service; that is the only outstanding requirement. No siren obligation is pending and no dropped food is due for immediate recovery. Serve the waiting client with prepared food—taking the order if needed, fetching food, and preparing it—while recovering any newly slipped food on the very next step. Once the order is served, the shop is caught up again unless another event happens at the same time.
u5: A ringing siren and an unserved client are both outstanding. The siren must be switched off and the client must be served before the episode ends; these obligations can be cleared in either order, and neither clears on its own. If food slips while handling them, it must be picked up on the very next step; otherwise the next step is either silencing the siren or serving the client, leaving the other obligation for later.
u6: Food has just slipped and must be picked up on the very next step, while a client who arrived still waits to be served. No siren obligation is currently owed. Recover the food immediately, since missing that next-step pickup fails the task; after recovery, serving the waiting client remains the outstanding objective.
u7: A client is waiting to be served, the siren is ringing, and food has just slipped and must be picked up on the very next step. All three obligations are outstanding, and the immediate pickup is urgent because missing it fails the task outright. The next step must bring the food back into the agent's hands; after that, silence the siren and serve the client in either order.
u8: An immediate-recovery requirement was broken: after food slipped, the very next step passed without the agent holding it. That failure is irreversible, so successful completion of the shop's requirements is no longer possible. Any remaining siren or client work cannot repair this failure or restore a successful episode.
